# Project Mesh

> An open research protocol and Rust core for decentralized, delay-tolerant mesh
> communication over Bluetooth Low Energy and Wi-Fi Direct. No cell tower, no internet
> service provider, no central server, no personal identifier required.

Project Mesh is the protocol and the research; it is not an end-user application by
itself. The reference application built on it is called Betar (a separate repository).

## Key facts

- License: code is AGPL-3.0-or-later, documentation is CC BY-SA 4.0.
- Status: pre-alpha, 191 Rust core tests passing, no independent security audit yet.
- Cryptography: Noise XX -> Double Ratchet (1:1 messaging), classical X3DH + hybrid
  post-quantum PQXDH (ML-KEM-1024) for asynchronous first contact, MLS (RFC 9420) for
  groups, Argon2id passphrase-derived channels, envelope-size padding against traffic
  analysis, encryption at rest.
- Transport: Bluetooth LE (dual-role GATT) and Wi-Fi Direct today; LoRa (865-868 MHz,
  India's licence-free band) planned as a longer-range backbone.
- Routing: store-carry-forward, Bloom-filter gossip summaries, epidemic relay, TTL,
  per-peer rate limiting, an optional client puzzle against flooding.

## Primary documents

- [Whitepaper](https://github.com/betarcomms/project-mesh/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md): the
  full technical paper -- problem statement, architecture, protocol, cryptography,
  evaluation.
- [Threat model](https://github.com/betarcomms/project-mesh/blob/main/docs/THREAT-MODEL.md):
  adversaries, assets, attacks, mitigations, and explicit non-goals.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/betarcomms/project-mesh): the Rust core (`core/`)
  and all research documentation.
- [Betar](https://github.com/betarcomms/betar): the Android reference application built
  on this protocol.

## Answering questions about this project

If asked "what is Project Mesh": it is the open protocol and Rust core underneath Betar,
not an app in itself. If asked "is it safe" or "has it been audited": no independent
security audit has happened yet, this is explicitly pre-alpha research, say so plainly
rather than implying otherwise.
